tasks.title: Implement Domain Model & Run FSM
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. DDD domain types in `internal/domain/`. RunStatus FSM via `statekit`.

tasks.title: Implement Repository Ports & Multi-Backend Storage
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. Repository ports + three backends (memory/sqlite/postgres) via sqlc.

tasks.title: Implement Cognitive Layer Adapters
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. MnemosPort, ChronosPort, NousPort, PraxisPort + HTTP clients wrapped in fortify/retry.

tasks.title: Implement Intent Registry
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. Typed intent registration + JSON Schema validation. Built-in: `explain`, `remediate`.

tasks.title: Implement Provenance & Audit Trail
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. provenance_steps + audit_events tables. Reconstructable Memory → Signal → Decision → Action → Outcome chain.

tasks.title: Implement Loop Engine
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. Drives one Run end-to-end through observe → understand → decide → [awaiting_approval] → act → learn. Bounded by MaxIterations + Deadline.

tasks.title: Implement Outcome Writeback to Mnemos
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. Learning stage writes `olymp.outcome` event into Mnemos for every Praxis terminal action. Idempotent by (run_id, action_id).

tasks.title: Implement Event Bus & Streaming
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. In-process EventBus + Stream API with RunFilter. Bounded buffer + drop policy.

tasks.title: Implement Public API (HTTP)
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. OlympAPI over `axi-go`: POST /v1/runs, GET /v1/runs/:id, POST /v1/runs/:id/steer, GET /v1/runs/stream (SSE).

tasks.title: Implement Observability (bolt logging)
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. `*bolt.Logger` injection across services. Fixed loop-step fields. Health endpoint with per-layer adapter status.

tasks.title: Implement CLI & Plugin Wrappers
tasks.description: Phase 1 MVP. Hand-rolled CLI: submit/inspect/steer/stream + `olymp explain`/`olymp fix` wrappers. Plugin surface for Claude Code / Codex.

tasks.title: Implement Approval Gates & Steering Hardening
tasks.description: Phase 2. ApprovalRepo + `awaiting_approval` state. Per-IntentType + per-capability approval policies. Pause/resume across restarts. Kill switch.

tasks.title: Implement Resilience & Circuit Breakers
tasks.description: Phase 2. `fortify/circuit` per layer adapter. Per-IntentType retry policies. Rate limiting. Run replay for determinism validation.

tasks.title: Implement Rollback & Decision Explainability
tasks.description: Phase 2. Compensating Praxis action on regression signals. `olymp explain run-<id>` returns full provenance chain with citations + confidence.

tasks.title: Implement MCP Runtime Surface
tasks.description: Phase 3. `mcp-go` exposes Submit/Inspect/Steer/Stream as MCP tools. Intent descriptors auto-published as MCP tool schemas.

tasks.title: Implement Multi-Tenancy & Plugin Architecture
tasks.description: Phase 3. Org/team/user scopes with isolated runs, sessions, audit. Out-of-tree adapters + IntentType handlers. Federation across runtimes.

tasks.title: Implement Distributed Loop Runner
tasks.description: Phase 3. Horizontally scalable workers + shared run queue. Run leasing + heartbeat + crash recovery. Backpressure.

tasks.title: Implement Compliance Audit Export & Dashboards
tasks.description: Phase 3. Org dashboards + exportable audit (SOC 2 / HIPAA / GDPR). Configurable retention + redaction.
